_meta.ui_note: UI takes percentages in plain percent (type 1 for 1%, 70 for 70%); the engine divides by 100. Money fields format with thousands separators.

ltv.notes: Bank Bridge / Dev Exit lenders reach 0.75; some to 0.80 for the right asset. Cap is per-lender from the waterfall.

calc_defaults_MASTER_V4_1.note: brokerPct default 1% — a low, illustration-friendly starting rate; DISCRETIONARY per deal (fee doctrine). NOTE: this is 1% (0.01), not 7.5%. Interest is charged on the subtotal for the term; rolled adds it to gross, serviced pays it monthly.

routing_rules.development_test: A value-enhancing intent stays a Standard Bridge unless it is GDV-driven/staged AND material in size (loan ≥ ~£1m; never ≤£500k). Ground-up is always Development; Development Exit is its own scorecard.
routing_rules.security_asset_rule: Development structuring applies only to the asset being developed. Raising on a property already owned to deploy elsewhere = Standard Bridge secured on that asset.
routing_rules.clean_charge_rule: On PA_MainBridge, existing 2nd/3rd charges are generally redeemed for a clean charge position; the headroom calc funds all redemptions before any net release.
routing_rules.bank_bridge_is_a_rate_lane: Bank Bridge is the lower-rate lane of the same Standard Bridge (same 70% cap, same PA_MainBridge). Never a borrower choice; the desk elevates pricing where security/size justify it.
routing_rules.land_lane_rule: Any case where the security is land (bare or with consent, no habitable dwelling) routes to Land Finance, purchase or refinance. Ground-up build cost funding stays Development Finance. A dwelling on the land in habitable use routes as property, not land.
